meta.build_gap: Builds after 69893 (69913, 69977, 70009, 70058, 70124): per ForeverChanges patch notes, the only Mage changes are in 70009 (Hot Streak 20 s, Wake of Fire 30 s, Arcane Missiles line of sight checked once, Ignite no double-counting). A diff of the sim spell store (70009) against the 69893 CSV over all 276 Mage spell ids found only Hot Streak (400625) and Wake of Fire (1312934) durations changed.
meta.formula: Value at player level L: avg = floor(base_avg_at_learn + per_level * (min(L, max_level) - spell_level)); min = avg*(1-variance/2), max = avg*(1+variance/2) (sim/core/spelldata/effect.go). Wowhead shows min/max at max_level and adds per_level to min and max separately; the two differ by under 1 point.
meta.coefficient_convention: sp_coefficient is per hit, per missile or per tick as stored in the client; totals are derived.
meta.unknown_marker: A value of null or a note starting UNKNOWN means no source settles it.
